riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who enjoy restoring complex machines to exact condition. Every work-card signature confirms the quality of your craft.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this work is that every signature matters. Each aircraft you inspect carries hundreds of lives. People who enjoy hands-on work, respect regulations, and take satisfaction in restoring a complex machine to proper condition can find deep achievement here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「把复杂机器修到完美」的人——每一道工卡签字都是对自己手艺的确认。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在于「每次签字都有分量」——你检查过的每一架飞机，都承载着几百条人命。喜欢动手、敬畏规章、享受把一台复杂机器修到「恢复出厂状态」的人，会在这里找到成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Art, Drama, And Music Teachers, Postsecondary

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine strong professional skills, clear explanations, and a willingness to mentor. Technique must be solid, and artistic feeling must be translated into language students understand.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to explain artistic feeling clearly. Personal mastery is not enough; you must translate technique, aesthetics, and expression into language students understand. It suits people who love their discipline, enjoy mentoring, and value the entire journey from beginner to stage.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers creative, helping, and practical work (Artistic A + Social S + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 高校艺术、戏剧和音乐教师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「专业强 + 会讲 + 愿带人」凑一块的人——技法要过硬，也要把感觉拆成学生懂的话。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把感觉讲清楚」——自己会还不够，要把技法、审美和表达拆成学生能懂的话。适合爱专业、也愿意带人的人，享受从入门到登台的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造、助人、也务实（艺术 A + 社会 S + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine a love of life science, deep inquiry, and tolerance for repetition. A new discovery can feel more valuable than anything else.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops curiosity with patience. You must tolerate repetition in the laboratory while continuing to ask why. It suits people who love nature, enjoy deep inquiry, accept slow results, and value the excitement of a new discovery.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and autonomy (Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱生命 + 能钻研 + 耐重复」凑一块的人——一个新发现比啥都值。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耐心里的好奇」——既要坐得住实验室重复，也要对「为什么」有股钻劲。适合爱自然、爱钻研、也接受慢出成果的人，也享受「一个新发现」的兴奋感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、实干、也自主（研究 I + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most satisfying part of this trade is creating something visible and tangible. Panels become furniture in your hands, and a customer can still remember the craftsperson after using the cabinets for years. A craftsperson's sense of achievement lives in those details.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying part of this trade is the visible result. A set of cabinets goes from drawing to finished product, and when a customer opens a drawer, touches the surface, and admires the workmanship, that recognition feels tangible and worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最踏实的是「作品看得见、摸得着」：一套橱柜在你手上从板材变成家具，客户用十年还记得「这是那位师傅做的」——手艺人的成就感，就藏在细节里。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「看得见的成品」：一套橱柜从图纸变成实物，客户打开抽屉、摸了摸台面说声「这活儿漂亮」，那种手艺被认可的感觉，比什么都实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Craft Artists are worth considering if you remain curious about the field and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work develops a close relationship with materials. It requires aesthetic judgment and acceptance that two or three pieces out of ten can fail. It suits dexterous, patient people who enjoy careful, unhurried work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers creative expression, hands-on implementation, and orderly processes (Artistic A + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Craft Artists有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，工艺艺术家值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和材料对话」——既要审美，也要接受十件里废两三件的常态。适合手巧、有耐心、享受慢工出细活的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造表达、动手实现、也重工序（艺术 A + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Crematory Operator work is worth considering if you remain curious about the field and are comfortable making low-risk operational judgments.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops discipline in solemn settings. Crematory Operators need exceptional care and must give grieving families steady confidence. It suits calm, rule-conscious, emotionally stable people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on operation, procedures, and monitoring (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Crematory Operators有持续好奇、又不排斥低风险下的判断，火化设备操作员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在肃穆里守流程」——既要心细如发，也要能给悲痛的家属稳稳的信赖。适合沉稳、守规矩、情绪稳定的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、重规程、也讲监测（现实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine visual judgment + steady hands + accountability. Slides must be interpreted accurately, and errors must be owned because every slide represents a person.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops meticulous accountability: sharp visual judgment, steady technique, and respect for the weight behind every slide. It suits people who can stay focused, work precisely, and approach human health with care.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigative, practical, and structured work (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「眼力 + 手稳 + 责任」凑一块的人——片子要看得准，误差也要担得起，每一张背后都是人。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细到极致的责任心」——既要眼力毒、手法稳，也要扛得住每一张片子背后的重量。适合坐得住、手稳、又对生命有敬畏的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、务实、也守规矩（研究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Electric Motor, Power Tool, And Related Repairers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy restoring broken equipment, this career offers that satisfaction every day. A customer's simple praise after collecting a repaired motor provides a tangible reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this trade is that experience gains value over time. A veteran who has repaired motors for decades can identify a fault by sound, a skill no book can teach. Repairers also have durable demand because machines break and someone must fix them.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 电机与电动工具修理工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你享受「坏东西在自己手里修好」的快感，这行每天都能给你：客户拿走修好的电机，回来一句「师傅手艺真好」，比什么奖励都实在。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最大的吸引力是「手艺越老越值钱」：修了二十年电机的老师傅，一听声音就知道故障在哪，这种经验书上学不到。而且修理工不怕失业——机器会坏，坏了就得有人修。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The certainty of a standard drawing can be deeply satisfying. Every symbol, number, and wire label follows a system, so construction teams can build from it. People who enjoy order and sustained concentration often value this work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest reward is the order created by a standard drawing. A tangled circuit becomes a clearly labeled, fully numbered document that construction teams understand immediately. Being trusted for that clarity provides tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Conventional C + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最让人安心的是「一张规范图纸的确定性」：所有符号、编号、线号都有章法，施工方按图施工就行。喜欢秩序感、坐得住的人会很享受。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最享受的是「一张规范的图纸带来的秩序感」：别人画得乱糟糟的电路，在你手里变成标注清晰、编号齐全、施工方一看就懂的图纸，那种被依赖的感觉很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 常规型 C + 现实型 R

breadcrumb.label: Electro Mechanical And Mechatronics Technologists And Technicians

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who combine manual dexterity, logic, and curiosity. The wiring must work, parameters must be correct, and machines must run.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation demands a cross-disciplinary mindset: technicians must understand mechanical power transmission, electrical circuits, controls, and programs. It suits people with strong hands-on skills who enjoy investigating principles and can trace problems to their source in a noisy setting. They prefer the site to a laboratory and do not mind getting dirty.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on investigation, values logic, and takes a practical approach (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 机电与机电一体化技师与技术员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手巧 + 逻辑好 + 爱琢磨」凑一块的人——线要通，参要正，机要转。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「交叉脑子」——既要懂机械传动，又要懂电路和控制，还得会看程序。适合动手强、爱琢磨原理、能在噪杂现场把问题查到底的人，坐不住实验室但也不怕脏。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手钻研、重逻辑、也务实（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Exercise Trainers And Group Fitness Instructors

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who love exercise, communicate openly, and show empathy. The greatest reward comes from watching clients grow stronger and more confident through your guidance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in witnessing change. A client progresses from struggling after a short run to completing 5 kilometers, or from significant excess weight to visible muscle definition. People who love exercise, enjoy working with others, and have empathy can turn that passion into income.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Realistic R + Enterprising E

breadcrumb.label: 健身训练师与团课教练

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「热爱运动、性格外向、有同理心」的人——客户在你手里一点点变强、变自信，就是这份工作最大的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「见证改变」：客户从跑两步就喘到能跑 5 公里，从大体重到练出线条，都有你的一份。喜欢运动、爱跟人打交道、有同理心的人，会在这里找到「用热爱赚钱」的感觉。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 实际型 R + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine composure, attention to detail, and organization. Materials must be gathered completely and entered accurately, with information flowing smoothly between systems and people.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops meticulous accuracy. Workers must understand documents, clarify loan purposes, and connect information smoothly between customers and systems. It suits composed, organized people who do not mind repeated verification and enjoy turning a pile of materials into a compliant application.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, helpful, and stable work (Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「稳重 + 细致 + 有条理」凑一块的人——材料要问全也要录准，系统和人之间要把信息接顺。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细到不犯错」——既要看懂材料、问清用途，也要在系统和人之间把信息接顺。适合稳重、有条理、不怕反复核对的人，也享受把一团材料理成一笔合规申请的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、助人、也稳定（企业 E + 社会 S + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Molders, Shapers, And Casters, Except Metal And Plastic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine hands-on skill + steady hands + interest in materials. Parts must be formed and thoroughly compacted, requiring a balance of technique and feel as well as careful inspection.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops precision in the hands. Workers must understand materials well enough to diagnose problems while maintaining steady control to compact parts. It suits hands-on, patient people who take responsibility for quality and enjoy turning raw materials into finished products.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, investigative, and conventional work (Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「动手 + 稳手 + 爱材料」凑一块的人——件要压得也要压实，技术和手感要平衡也要会检。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上的精度」——既要懂材料看得准病，也要有把件压实的稳手。适合动手强、坐得住、也愿意对质量负责的人，也享受从原料到成品的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也常规（务实 R + 钻研 I + 常规 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine aesthetic judgment, technology, and patience. The imagery must look good and be executable, requiring a balance of creativity and revisions as well as strong communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops aesthetic judgment and patience. The imagery must look good, the technical execution must be strong, and revisions must be endured. It suits people with an art foundation who can work patiently, enjoy experimenting with software, and appreciate the achievement of turning still images into motion.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers artistic and investigative work while remaining practical (Artistic A + Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「审美 + 技术 + 耐心」凑一块的人——画面要好看也要做得出，创意和改稿要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「审美与耐心」——画面要好看，技术要硬，改稿要扛得住。适合有美术底、坐得住、爱折腾软件的人，也享受把静态变动态的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好艺术、研究、也务实（艺术 A + 研究 I + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people with strength in their hands and kindness in their hearts. You do not prescribe medication, but you ensure that every patient receives steady care in the ward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies not in technology but in lending a hand. When an older patient returns to the ward after surgery, you guide the bed smoothly through the corridor until the hand gripping the rail slowly relaxes. That feeling of being needed is the most tangible part of the job.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Social S + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手上有劲、心里有善意」的人——你不负责开药，但你负责让每个患者在病区里被稳稳地照顾到。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值不在技术，而在「搭把手」：一个刚做完手术的老人要回病房，你平稳地推着他穿过走廊，他握着床栏的那只手慢慢放松了——这种被需要的感觉，是这行最实在的部分。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 社会型 S + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about Penetration Testers and accept judgment under high-risk conditions, penetration testing is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to think like an attacker while following rules. Professionals must understand attacks and translate findings into recommendations executives can understand. It suits people who enjoy offense and defense, respect boundaries, and communicate clearly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, clear standards, and business operations (Investigative I + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Penetration Testers有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，渗透测试员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「站在坏人这边想」——既要懂攻，也要能写成老板看得懂的建议。适合爱攻防、守规矩、表达清的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、重规范、也讲经营（研究 I + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines steady hands + patience + curiosity about materials. Clay must be thoroughly prepared, bodies must be thrown straight, and glaze must fire to a lustrous finish.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops tactile control and patience. The clay's moisture, wheel speed, and fire color in the kiln are learned through years of experience. It suits steady-handed people who can stay focused, enjoy the journey from clay to vessel, and tolerate workshop dust and heat.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on, practical, and creative work (Realistic R + Artistic A + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 耐心 + 爱琢磨材料」凑一块的人——泥要练透，坯要拉正，釉要烧润。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感与耐心」——泥的干湿、转盘的速度、窑里的火色，全靠长年摸出来。适合坐得住、手稳、又享受从泥到器过程的人，也耐得住车间粉尘和热。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手、务实、也创造（现实 R + 艺术 A + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Sales Representatives, Wholesale And Manufacturing, Technical And Scientific Products

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about sales of wholesale and manufacturing technical and scientific products and accept judgment under high risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to earn trust through expertise. It requires technical knowledge and the ability to close deals, suiting logical, inquisitive, resilient people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers business decisions, standards, and analysis (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Sales Representatives, Wholesale And Manufacturing, Technical And Scientific Products有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，销售代表、批发制造、产品值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「用专业换信任」——既要懂技术，也要会成交。适合逻辑强、爱钻研、能抗压的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好经营决策、重规范、也讲分析（企业 E + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

breadcrumb.label: Substance Abuse And Behavioral Disorder Counselors

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who view helping others as a mission and can withstand frustration. Watching someone who has failed repeatedly finally stand up again offers an irreplaceable sense of purpose.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The sense of achievement in this field comes from witnessing someone stand up again. A client 90 days into recovery says for the first time, 'I want a normal life,' or a family member tearfully thanks you. Helping pull someone back from the edge of an abyss is the deepest source of meaning in this work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Artistic A

breadcrumb.label: 物质滥用行为障碍咨询师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「助人」当使命、又扛得住挫败感的人——看着一个反复失败的人最终重新站起来，这种价值感没有替代品。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感是「见证一个人重新站起来」：看着一位戒断 90 天的来访者第一次主动说「我想过正常生活」，或者一位家属红着眼眶跟你说谢谢——这种把一个人从深渊边缘拉回来的价值，是这份工作最深的底色。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who follow rules and withstand monotony. Even through the same tunnel every day, treating every run like the first reflects true professionalism.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The reassuring part of this work is that every day runs on schedule. During crowded peaks, you deliver every train to each station on time from the cab. Returning the last train to the depot completes another day of safely getting people where they need to go.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「守得住规矩、扛得住单调」的人——每天同一段隧道，你把每一班都当第一次开，这就是职业素养。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「天天都按点」——高峰挤成沙丁鱼，你在驾驶室把每一站准点送上；末班车收班回库，一天的「送达」完成，就是成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who combine love of nature + rigor + observation. Samples must be placed correctly and interpreted accurately, requiring a balance between data and conclusions and strong communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops observation and rigor. Samples must be placed correctly, data interpreted accurately, and conclusions supported convincingly. It suits people who love nature, remain patient, and are curious about life, while offering the satisfaction of understanding populations.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative and practical preferences (Investigative I + Realistic R).

breadcrumb.label: 动物学家与野生生物学家

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱自然 + 严谨 + 观察」凑一块的人——样要布得对也要读得准，数据和结论要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「观察与严谨」——样要布得对，数据要读得准，结论要立得住。适合爱自然、坐得住、对生命有好奇的人，也享受把种群摸清的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、务实（研究 I + 现实 R）。
